description: The National Flood Asset Database records flood infrastructure in Wales managed by the Lead Local Flood Authorities and Natural Resources Wales, produced from their asset management systems under measures 6 to 8 of the National Flood Strategy. Three layers are open: flood defence locations (embankments, walls, flood gates and other assets against river and sea flooding, with type, length, maintainer and id), culverts, and culvert openings and screens. Coverage is Wales. The data are free under the Open Government Licence through DataMapWales, with downloads and WMS and WFS services. Caveats: the database does not hold all flood assets or any coastal erosion protection, culvert locations are indicative only and may be inaccurate or out of date, and condition is not among the listed attributes. Simulation uses: defence alignments and culverts for flood hazard, overtopping and blockage scenarios. Related records: England's spatial flood defences (data-ea-aims-spatial-flood-defences) and the Dutch primary flood defences (data-netherlands-primary-flood-defences-nbpw).
